Triage: `domain:engine` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) · p2 · Bug · `area:devpath`; rationale: one ternary branch validated, the other not — and a comment that just landed makes the omission look deliberate

`Path: 不写代码在运行中改应用 | platform-core.packaged-object-extend-only | P④ | p2`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T17:32Z. ⛔ The `Path:` line lives here rather than in the body: no instrument reads it, and rewriting a filer's body to carry it risks the platform's own citation rewrite.

**Class (c) with (b) beside it, re-read by this seat on today's `origin/main`** — and the card is MORE right than when it was filed, because PR #19574 has since landed:

```
// ⛔ An explicitly declared `targetNamespace` still wins untouched: it
// is the caller's decision and this seam is about the DEFAULT.
const targetNs: string | null =
    request.targetNamespace ?? deriveNamespaceFromPackageId(request.targetPackageId);
```

The loud `400` beneath it fires only on `!targetNs` ⇒ the **derived** branch now refuses with a remedy and the **explicit** branch is still unchecked, while that value is spliced into every copied object name.

⚠️ **The card's line cite `:19275` is stale** — the construct sits at `:19379` today. The fact holds; the number drifted. ⛔ Whoever takes this re-reads the line rather than trusting either number.

⭐ **Why it needs an act rather than silence**: the new comment reads as a deliberate carve-out. Either it IS one — in which case the object-name charset contract (`/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/`, published in `@objectstack/spec`) must be honoured some other way — or it is an oversight. Leaving a comment that blesses the gap is the worst of the three.

**Dedupe** — 1 open hit each on `duplicatePackage` and `targetNamespace` (this card); #19417 is closed and its scope was the derived seam only. Sibling #19576 is a different door, ⛔ not a duplicate.
